messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Plotting more than 3 pheno traits
parts:
Another approach to this plotting:

ymx <- max(out.pheno.all[,-(1:2)], na.rm=TRUE)
plot(out.pheno.all, ylim=c(0, ymx))
for(i in 2:4)
plot(out.pheno.all, lod=i, col=c("blue", "red", "green")[i-1], add=TRUE)

karl


On Nov 8, 2012, at 3:30 PM, Zeb <wzre...@ucdavis.edu> wrote:

> Simple question but I couldn't find the answer in any of the tutorials. How can you plot more than 3 traits?
>
> I tried:
>
> out.pheno.all <- scanone (object, pheno.col=c(1,2,3,4))
> plot(out.pheno.all, lodcolumn=c(1,2,3,4), lty=1, col=c("blue", "red", "green", "black") )
>
> but it only shows the first three.
>
